decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressive tactics while disrupting the opponent's game plan using a combination of removal spells and hand disruption. The creatures in the deck have abilities that can disrupt the opponent's strategy, such as exiling cards from the graveyard or forcing opponents to discard cards. By utilizing these disruptive elements alongside aggressive creatures, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory. It also includes a mix of lands to ensure consistency in mana availability.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach in combination with various artifacts like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Grinding Station to create a powerful combo that can quickly mill through the deck and win the game through alternate win conditions like Thassa's Oracle. The deck also includes disruption elements like Spell Pierce and Lightning Bolt to control the game and protect the combo. With a mix of acceleration from Mox Opal and other mana sources, the deck aims to quickly set up its combo and win the game in a burst of powerful plays.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's game plan with disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while also utilizing creatures with powerful abilities to control the board and apply pressure. The deck focuses on generating value through blink effects like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, as well as utilizing powerful creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Ketramose, the New Dawn. By combining aggressive creatures with disruptive spells, this deck aims to outvalue and outpace the opponent in order to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on quickly bringing out powerful creatures and disrupting the opponent's strategy with hand disruption and graveyard hate. The key strategy is to use cards like Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt the opponent's hand, while also using cards like Necrodominance and Soul Spike to quickly bring out and empower powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Ketramose, the New Dawn. The deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent early on and maintain control of the game through its disruptive elements and efficient creatures.

The deck focuses on using artifacts to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. It utilizes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal to generate mana and card advantage, while also leveraging Emry, Lurker of the Loch to recur key artifacts from the graveyard. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence early on and disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Pithing Needle and Metallic Rebuke. Urza's Saga provides additional value by tutoring for important artifacts, making it a versatile and powerful card in the deck.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and direct damage spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. With powerful cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, along with support from cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, the deck aims to deal damage fast and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge adds extra reach and control options, while the mana base allows for consistent and smooth gameplay. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive and push for a quick victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach in combination with Grinding Station and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to create an infinite milling loop. By casting artifacts from the graveyard and sacrificing them with Grinding Station, the player can mill their opponent's entire deck and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. The deck includes various ways to turbocharge the combo with cards like Mox Opal and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, as well as disruption spells like Malevolent Rumble and Sink into Stupor to control the game until the combo is assembled.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to control the board and apply pressure to the opponent. With cards like Solitude and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer leading the early game, supported by removal spells like Fatal Push, the deck aims to quickly establish dominance and maintain tempo advantage. Ephemerate and Flickerwisp provide additional utility and disruption, while cards like Ketramose, the New Dawn and Overlord of the Balemurk offer powerful late-game threats to close out the game. With a mix of aggression and control, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions by using counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up its own win condition through card advantage and powerful threats like Murktide Regent. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion and card draw to maintain a constant stream of threats and answers. By efficiently managing resources and anticipating the opponent's moves, this Dimir Control deck aims to outlast and outplay its opponents in the late game.

This deck focuses on using Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to create a powerful combo with creatures that can be searched for using Chord of Calling and Green Sun's Zenith. The deck also includes toolbox creatures like Endurance for graveyard hate and Grist, the Hunger Tide for additional value. The deck aims to control the board with versatile creatures like Walking Ballista and Wall of Roots, while also using sacrifice outlets like Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Marionette Apprentice to generate value and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using cards like Goblin Charbelcher and Thundertrap Trainer to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent quickly. By utilizing a landless strategy, the deck is able to consistently cast its spells and disrupt the opponent's game plan using counterspells like Spell Snare and Force of Negation. The deck also includes cards like Hydroelectric Specimen and Fallaji Archaeologist to generate additional value and fuel the combo. With a mix of control elements and powerful combo pieces, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and burn spells to deal damage quickly to the opponent. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Seasoned Pyromancer, backed up by burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment. The deck also includes cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ranger-Captain of Eos for additional value and control. Overall, the key strategy of this deck is to apply pressure early and maintain board presence to secure a quick victory.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card advantage. By using cards like Fatal Push, Counterspell, and Force of Negation, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and prevent them from establishing a strong board presence. Additionally, cards like Relic of Progenitus and Psychic Frog provide card advantage and graveyard hate. The deck also includes creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Ketramose, the New Dawn to deal with threats on the board. Overall, the deck focuses on controlling the game and out-valuing the opponent.

The deck focuses on using various spells to fill the graveyard with creatures, then bringing them back onto the battlefield for explosive plays. It utilizes a combination of discard spells, removal, and reanimation effects to control the game while setting up its combo pieces. The key strategy is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures, then bring them back for massive swings in tempo and advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its powerful reanimated threats while disrupting their game plan with hand disruption and removal spells.

This deck aims to control the game by utilizing Eldrazi creatures and ramping up mana quickly. The key strategy involves playing ramp cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple to accelerate into powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. Karn, the Great Creator is also crucial for locking down opponents' threats. By using a combination of removal spells like All Is Dust and Malevolent Rumble, as well as disruption with cards like Kozilek's Command, the deck aims to establish board control and overwhelm opponents with its powerful creatures.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays, utilizing powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to quickly deal damage to the opponent. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional support and buffing for your creatures, while cards like Galvanic Discharge and Guide of Souls help control the board. The deck also includes some removal options like Static Prison and Goblin Bombardment to deal with threats. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creature plays and aggressive tactics.
